prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A cinematic, close-up overhead shot of a tablet lying on a dark, textured surface, possibly a carpet or felt. The tablet screen displays a vibrant, stylized fighting game with two cartoonish characters in mid-battle: one on the left wearing a conical hat and white martial arts attire, the other on the right in orange clothing, both in dynamic fighting poses with exaggerated hand gestures. The game interface features health bars and circular icons at the top corners. The lighting is warm and soft, casting gentle shadows and creating a cozy, intimate atmosphere. In the foreground, slightly out of focus, a hand and part of an arm reach toward the tablet, adding depth and a sense of interaction. The composition emphasizes the action on the screen while subtly including the human element, with a shallow depth of field and a natural, documentary-style aesthetic.
